prompt: Two students review the same lecture. One transcribes it word for word; the other writes short summaries in her own words and questions she still has. On a test asking them to apply the ideas, who is better prepared, and why?

options.text: The summariser, because rephrasing forces her to process meaning and reveals what she does not yet understand
The transcriber, because more words of notes always means more learning
Both equally, because notes only matter if they are complete
Neither, because note-taking has no effect on understanding

explanation: Verbatim copying can happen without thinking. Generative notes — summarising and questioning in your own words — require processing the ideas, which is what application questions test.
